purpose.zh: 拉伸小腿深层，改善踝关节活动度
purpose.en: Stretch the deeper calf and improve ankle mobility.

text.zh: 后脚跟踩实，双膝微屈往前下沉
text.en: Keep your back heel down and bend both knees to sink forward

text.zh: 小步前后站，双手扶墙保持平衡
text.en: Take a short split stance with your hands on the wall for balance.

text.zh: 在小腿下段有拉伸感处停住，慢慢呼吸
text.en: Stop where you feel the lower calf stretch and breathe slowly.

cautions.zh: 穿防滑鞋，扶稳墙面；疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Wear non-slip shoes and use a stable wall; ease off if it hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
